items.title: Acute Imbalance Syndrome vs Acute Vestibular Syndrome: Clinical and Topographical Differentiation.
items.abstract: Stroke is a major differential diagnosis in patients with acute vertigo/dizziness or imbalance. Current diagnostic algorithms such as head impulse test, gaze-evoked nystagmus, and test of skew are optimized for presentations with spontaneous nystagmus (SPN), traditionally called acute vestibular syndrome (AVS). However, in recent studies, a relevant proportion of patients with stroke-related vertigo/dizziness had no SPN, but rather postural or gait imbalance, a phenotype lately termed acute imbalance syndrome (AIS). We aimed to outline the pathoanatomical differences of stroke-related AIS vs AVS and its clinical implications. Patients with MRI-proven stroke-related acute vertigo/dizziness or imbalance were included in this emergency department (ED) cohort study at LMU Hospital prospectively. Vestibular, ocular motor, and postural signs were documented (including SPN presence/intensity by video oculography, postural imbalance by posturography). Patients were classified as suffering from AIS or AVS based on the presence of SPN. Stroke lesion distribution was depicted in Montreal Neurological Institute space and supplemented by structural disconnectome mapping from the lesion cores. Multivariate lesion symptom-mapping based on support-vector regression and disconnectome mapping was applied for SPN intensity and sway path as surrogate markers for AVS and AIS. Of 75 patients (age: 65.7 ± 13.3 years, 40% female), 58.7% were diagnosed with AIS, 38.7% with AVS, and 2.7% with central positional vertigo. In AIS, the lesion core was located in the anterior cerebellar lobe and deep cerebellar nuclei (superior cerebellar artery/posterior inferior cerebellar artery territory) connecting to the bilateral pontomesencephalic tegmentum through the superior cerebellar peduncle. AVS stroke lesions were mostly located in the posterior cerebellar/flocculonodular lobe (posterior inferior cerebellar artery/anterior inferior cerebellar artery territory) and connected to the ipsilesional vestibular nucleus (VN) and bilateral medial longitudinal fascicle (MLF) through the inferior cerebellar peduncle. SPN intensity correlated with voxels in the cerebellar lobules VI-IX connecting to VN and MLF. Postural sway was associated with a small local cluster in the cerebellar Crus I. AIS accounts for more than half of patients with stroke-related vertigo/dizziness or imbalance. AIS lesions were located in the anterior cerebellar lobe, disturbing cerebellar-pontomesencephalic networks for posture and gait control. AVS lesions affected the posterior cerebellar/flocculonodular lobe and associated vestibulo-ocular reflex networks. Recognition of both clinical phenotypes is essential to identify all strokes among patients with vertigo/dizziness in the emergency setting. DRKS00008992; U1111-1172-8719.
items.summary_ja:
背景：急性めまい・ふらつき患者において、脳卒中は重要な鑑別診断である。従来の診断法は自発性眼振（SPN）を伴う急性前庭症候群（AVS）に最適化されているが、SPNを伴わず姿勢や歩行の不安定さを主症状とする急性不均衡症候群（AIS）が近年注目されている。  
方法：MRIで脳卒中が証明された急性めまい・ふらつき患者75名を対象に、SPNの有無でAISとAVSに分類。眼球運動、姿勢制御をビデオ眼球運動計測や姿勢計測で評価し、病変部位をモントリオール神経学研究所空間で解析。支持ベクトル回帰による多変量病変症状マッピングを実施。  
結果：患者の58.7%がAIS、38.7%がAVSと診断。AISの病変は前部小脳葉と深部小脳核（上小脳動脈・後下小脳動脈領域）に集中し、姿勢・歩行制御に関与する小脳橋中脳網に連結。AVSは後部小脳葉・前庭核に関連し、前庭眼反射ネットワークに影響。SPN強度は小脳葉VI-IXと前庭核・内側縦束に相関。姿勢の揺れは小脳Crus Iに関連。  
結論：AISは脳卒中関連のめまい・ふらつき患者の過半数を占め、小脳前部の姿勢制御ネットワーク障害が原因である。AVSは後部小脳の前庭眼反射ネットワーク障害であり、両者の臨床的区別は救急診療での脳卒中診断に不可欠である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、急性めまい・ふらつき患者における脳卒中診断のため、従来の急性前庭症候群（AVS）に加え、姿勢・歩行障害を主症状とする急性バランス障害症候群（AIS）を検討した。AISは前小脳葉と深部小脳核に病変が集中し、姿勢制御ネットワークを障害。一方、AVSは後小脳葉と前庭眼反射ネットワークに関与。AISは脳卒中関連症例の過半数を占め、両者の鑑別が救急診療での脳卒中見逃し防止に重要である。

items.title: Effects of Blood Pressure Lowering by Hematoma Location in Acute Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
items.abstract: Early intensive blood pressure (BP) lowering is now recognized as an effective approach to improve outcome after acute intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). However, whether the effect varies by hematoma location is uncertain. We aimed to determine the heterogeneity of the treatment effect of intensive BP lowering on functional outcome by hematoma location. We conducted a pooled analysis of individual patient-level data (IPD) from all 4 Intensive Blood Pressure Reduction in Acute Cerebral Hemorrhage Trials (INTERACT) and the second Antihypertensive Treatment of Acute Cerebral Hemorrhage (ATACH-II) trial, which were international, randomized, open, blinded end point assessed, controlled trials that investigated the effectiveness of early intensive BP control in acute ICH. ICH location was classified as lobar or deep hemisphere or infratentorial. The primary outcome was death or disability (modified Rankin Scale scores 3-6) at 90 days or 6 months (for INTERACT3). The heterogeneity of the treatment effect of intensive BP lowering on the primary outcome by ICH location was estimated using generalized linear mixed models with trial as a random effect and adjustment for prespecified clinical covariates and an interaction term of "treatment-by-location." Among 11,288 patients (mean age 62.5 years [SD 12.7]; 4,056 [35.9%] women), 1,141 (10.1%) had lobar ICH, 9,202 (81.5%) had deep ICH and 945 (8.4%) had infratentorial ICH. Compared with deep or infratentorial ICH, lobar ICH occurred in older patients, was less often associated with intraventricular hemorrhage, and had larger hematoma volumes (all  Hematoma location modifies the treatment effect of intensive BP lowering on functional outcome after ICH, with the benefit observed only in deep ICH. These trials are registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (INTERACT1 NCT00226096; INTERACT2 NCT00716079; INTERACT3 NCT03209258; INTERACT4 NCT03790800; and ATACH-II NCT01176565).
items.summary_ja:
背景：急性脳内出血（ICH）後の早期集中的血圧（BP）低下は予後改善に有効とされるが、血腫の部位による効果の違いは不明であった。  
方法：INTERACTおよびATACH-IIの4つの国際ランダム化試験の個別患者データ11,288例を統合解析し、血腫部位（葉状、深部半球、幕下）別に集中的BP低下の機能的転帰（90日または6か月の死亡・障害率）への影響を評価。一般化線形混合モデルを用い、試験間のランダム効果と臨床共変量を調整した。  
結果：患者の81.5%が深部ICH、10.1%が葉状ICH、8.4%が幕下ICHであった。葉状ICHは高齢者に多く、脳室内出血は少なく血腫量は大きかった。集中的BP低下の利益は深部ICH群でのみ有意に認められ、葉状および幕下ICHでは効果が見られなかった。  
結論：ICHの血腫部位は集中的BP低下の治療効果を修飾し、機能的転帰の改善は深部ICHに限定されることが示された。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性脳内出血（ICH）患者11,288例の解析で、血腫の部位別に集中的降圧治療の効果を検討した。結果、深部ICHでは集中的降圧が機能的予後改善に有効であったが、葉状および小脳下部ICHでは効果が認められなかった。血腫の位置が降圧治療の効果に影響を与えることが示された。

items.title: Relationship Between Braak and Clinical Stage in Autopsy-Confirmed Parkinson Disease: A UK Brain Bank Study.
items.abstract: The gold standard for Parkinson disease (PD) diagnosis is postmortem examination, based on the presence and distribution of pathologic α-synuclein (Lewy pathology) across brain regions. Whether pathologic α-synuclein Braak staging reflects clinical disease progression remains uncertain. We examined the relationship between Braak stage with clinical indices of PD progression in an autopsy-proven cohort. We performed a retrospective clinicopathologic analysis of autopsy-confirmed PD cases from the Parkinson's UK Brain Bank (Imperial College London). Clinical records were systematically reviewed to extract age at symptom onset, disease duration, brain weight, Hoehn and Yahr (H&Y) stage at death, and key clinical features. Normality was assessed using Shapiro-Wilk tests; comparisons across Braak stages used Kruskal-Wallis tests. Correlations with Braak stage were examined using Spearman correlation with 95% CIs. Prevalence of major copathologies was summarized descriptively. Of 119 clinically diagnosed PD cases, we included all 61 with autopsy confirmation and available Braak staging. Mean ± SD age at death was 79.1 ± 7.4 years, disease duration was 13.5 ± 5.8 years, H&Y stage at death was 4.0 ± 0.8, and brain weight was 1,234.2 ± 108 g. Braak stage was not correlated with H&Y at death (ρ = 0.146, 95% CI -0.11 to 0.39,  Braak stage was not associated with H&Y at death, disease duration, age at death, or brain weight in autopsy-proven PD patients. These findings provide evidence that pathologic α-synuclein-based staging does not represent a model of clinical progression in PD. The quantification of both monomeric and pathologic α-synuclein may be needed to overcome the clinical limitations of pathology-based staging.
items.summary_ja:
背景：パーキンソン病（PD）の診断のゴールドスタンダードは、死後の脳検査による病理的α-シヌクレイン（レビー病変）の分布評価であるが、Braak病期が臨床的進行を反映するかは不明である。  
方法：英国パーキンソンズUK脳バンクの自験例を対象に、死後確認されたPD症例61例の臨床記録を遡及的に解析。発症年齢、病期（Hoehn and Yahrスケール）、病理学的Braak病期、脳重量などを抽出し、統計的に関連性を検討した。  
結果：平均死亡年齢79.1歳、病期4.0、病歴13.5年の症例で、Braak病期はHoehn and Yahr病期、病歴期間、死亡年齢、脳重量と有意な相関を示さなかった（ρ=0.146、95%CI -0.11～0.39）。  
結論：病理的α-シヌクレインに基づくBraak病期は、PDの臨床進行を反映するモデルとは言えない。臨床的評価には、単量体および病理的α-シヌクレインの定量化が必要と示唆された。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、英国パーキンソン病脳バンクの剖検確定例61例を対象に、病理的α-シヌクレインのBraakステージと臨床進行指標（Hoehn and Yahrステージ、病期、死亡時年齢、脳重量）との関連を検討した。結果、Braakステージは臨床進行度と有意な相関を示さず、病理学的ステージングが臨床進行を反映しないことを示唆した。今後は単量体および病理的α-シヌクレインの定量化が必要とされる。

items.title: Emergency Department Visits for Falls and First-Time Seizure.
items.abstract: Unrecognized seizures occur in up to 77% of individuals with epilepsy, leading to delays in diagnosis with significant consequences including injury, mortality, impaired psychosocial functioning, and negative socioeconomic impacts. Falls are a common reason to present to the emergency department (ED) and may be a sentinel sign of an unrecognized seizure. Whether falls represent missed opportunities for earlier seizure recognition remains unknown. We therefore evaluated the temporal association between ED visits for falls and first-time seizure. We conducted a retrospective case-crossover study using the State Inpatient Databases and State Emergency Department Databases from 11 states (Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Massachusetts, Maryland, Nebraska, New York, Utah, Vermont, and Wisconsin) between 2016 and 2021. Adults aged 18 years and older with an acute care visit for a first-time seizure were identified using ICD-10 codes. Using patients as their own controls, we applied conditional logistic regression to compare the odds of an ED visit for a fall during prespecified case periods preceding the seizure (1-7, 8-30, 31-90, and 91-180 days prior) vs corresponding control periods 1 year earlier. Prespecified intervals were selected to assess graded temporal proximity. There were 57,547 patients with a first-time seizure and 7,307 patients (mean age 49.3 years and 55.2% female) with at least one prior ED visit for a fall during the case or control periods. ED visits for a fall were more common in case compared with control periods, with the highest odds in the 7 days immediately before the acute care visit for first-time seizure (OR = 2.6, 95% CI 2.2-3.2). In a week-by-week analysis, the association persisted up to 22 weeks before seizure, demonstrating temporal attenuation as time from the event increased. These findings were consistent across age and sex strata and after excluding those who had traumatic brain injury. In analyses restricted to first-time status epilepticus, the association in the 7 days preceding seizure was most pronounced (OR = 4.5, 95% CI 2.5-9.0). ED visits for falls are more common immediately preceding first-time seizure, potentially representing missed opportunities for earlier diagnosis, evaluation, and intervention. Prospective studies are needed to clarify the underlying mechanisms and clinical implications.
items.summary_ja:
背景：てんかん患者の最大77％で発作が見逃され、診断遅延により負傷や死亡、社会的機能障害など深刻な影響が生じる。転倒は救急外来受診の一般的な理由であり、未認識の発作の前兆である可能性があるが、その関連性は不明であった。  
方法：2016～2021年の11州の入院・救急データベースを用い、18歳以上の初回発作患者57,547人を対象に、発作前の転倒による救急受診の頻度を患者自身を対照とした症例交差研究で評価。発作前1～7日、8～30日、31～90日、91～180日の期間と1年前の同期間を比較した。  
結果：7,307人が発作前後に転倒で救急受診しており、発作直前7日間の転倒受診は発作時より2.6倍多かった（95％CI 2.2-3.2）。この関連は最大22週間前まで持続し、年齢・性別や外傷性脳損傷除外後も一貫。初回重積発作では直前7日間の関連が最も強く（OR=4.5、95％CI 2.5-9.0）認められた。  
結論：転倒による救急受診は初回発作直前に増加し、早期診断や介入の機会逸失を示唆する。今後、機序解明と臨床的意義を明らかにする前向き研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 初発てんかん発作患者の救急外来受診データを解析した結果、発作直前の7日間に転倒による受診が有意に増加（OR=2.6）し、最大22週間前まで関連が認められた。特に初回てんかん重積状態では関連が強く（OR=4.5）、転倒は未診断てんかんの早期発見の機会を示唆する。転倒を契機とした早期診断・介入の重要性が示され、今後の前向き研究が求められる。
